name: Rug-Bound Wasps Trap (CR 6)
body:
Rug-Bound Wasps Trap
CR 6 (XP 2,400)

STATISTICS

Type magic; Notice Perception DC 30; Remove Disable Device DC 30; Trigger proximity (alarm); Reset none

EFFECTS

Spell insect plague; CL 12th; the wasp swarms follow creatures but do not leave this room)
